overall_notes: The original extraction was generally accurate. Main improvements were consolidating redundant human evaluation guideline information and normalizing metric capitalization. The paper focuses on question paraphrase generation with a novel disentangled encoding approach (SEPARATOR) and includes both automatic metrics (iBLEU, BLEU, Self-BLEU) and human evaluation (meaning preservation, dissimilarity, fluency).
